game.intro: April Fools! The moon swapped the salt and sugar. You swap every right answer for a wrong one.
game.question: What do bees make?

game.intro: The Great Puddle Census is underway. The crew needs audio of every splash. Make some noise.
game.prompt: A wet sound: boots in a puddle, a drip from the eaves, rain on a tin roof, a dog shaking off.

game.intro: The fog machine is on again. Through the haze, the tabloid camera clicks. Fill in the scoop.
game.headline: FOG ROLLS IN, REFUSES TO LEAVE UNTIL ___, TOWN NEGOTIATORS SUMMONED

game.intro: Matching sand shovels? DES. Saturn has a year in mind. Get close, don't go over, keep your shovel.
game.question: In what year was Canada's red-and-white maple leaf flag first raised as the national flag?
game.source: Proclaimed and first officially raised on February 15, 1965 (now National Flag of Canada Day)

game.intro: The blank page has opinions and so does Saturn. Three pairs, fast. No second drafts.
The Ram kicked open the door. Spark day! Pick your adventure, then guess your friend's.
game.question: You can start one ridiculous new hobby tomorrow. Which one?

game.intro: Courage can be borrowed. So can objects. Show something that isn't really yours, up close.
game.prompt: Something you borrowed and never quite gave back. Zoom so close it can't testify against you.

game.intro: The Bull wants a nap, so keep your wrong answers short and sleepy. Or don't. Saturn decides.
game.question: How many hours are in a day?

game.intro: The snowbank is giving back everything it ate all winter. Narrate the thaw, sound effects only.
game.prompt: Melting: a slow drip, slush sliding off a roof, a snowbank sighing, a lost mitten resurfacing.

game.intro: The Twins started a group chat. Answer the way they would: emoji only, zero letters, max drama.
game.prompt: A movie or show about two of something: twins, best friends, a pair of very odd ducks.

game.intro: Sunday of two opinions. Three stories, two true, one invented. Saturn already knows which.
game.prompt: Three opinions you have held very strongly at some point in your life. One you never held.

game.intro: The soup moon rises, warm and sloshy. Three pairs, ten seconds. Spoons ready.
An identical sandwich prophecy? DES. Pick your sandwich, guess theirs. A match gets a gasp.
game.question: Which sandwich would you defend in a courtroom?

game.intro: The Lion takes the stage! Find the most dramatic object in the house and give it a close-up.
game.prompt: Something shiny, sparkly or sequined, shot so close it looks like a disco planet.

game.intro: Backwards hat day. The crew is answering backwards too. Wrong answers only, bonus for style.
game.question: In which direction does the sun rise?

game.intro: The clipboard moon is checking boxes. Make a sound worth a checkmark and let the other guess.
game.prompt: An office sound: a stapler chomping, hold music, a squeaky chair, a printer jamming.

game.intro: The quest for the perfect pebble has gone public. Reporters are on the beach. Fill the blank.
game.headline: PERFECT PEBBLE FOUND ON SHORE, EXPERTS CLAIM IT ___

game.intro: Last polish before the party. Saturn polished a year. Guess close and don't you dare go over.
game.question: In what year did Newfoundland join Canada as its tenth province?

game.intro: The Full Moon Recharge begins. Ruby, onyx, moonlight. Three pairs to warm up the batteries.
The owls agreed on a DES night. Can you two agree? Pick yours, guess theirs, hoot if you match.
game.question: Which night sound would you most like to fall asleep to?

game.intro: The Scorpion is collecting stones. Join in, but only show a tiny corner of yours.
game.prompt: A stone, rock, gem or pebble, shot so close the other has to guess where it came from.

game.intro: Five elements roll call! Earth, fire, water, wind, heart. Answer wrong and keep it brief.
game.question: What do plants need from the sun to grow?

game.intro: The Archer packed a picnic. Make the sound of something at a picnic and let your friend guess it.
game.prompt: A picnic sound: a cooler lid, a fly that won't leave, a can popping open, a blanket in the wind.

game.intro: Kite without a string! Spark day. Let your thumbs fly free, emoji only, no letters allowed.
game.prompt: Something you'd love to do on the first warm, windy day of spring.

game.intro: The Goat climbs home today. Three tales from your own climbs, two true, one invented. Go.
game.prompt: Three things you have climbed: a tree, a hill, a ladder, a very tall bunk bed. One is made up.

game.intro: Slow and steady Monday. Take all ten seconds per pair. Saturn approves of a leisurely pace.
Goats appeared out of nowhere. DES! Choose your goat-adjacent fate and guess your friend's.
game.question: A goat moves in with you for a week. What is its job?

game.intro: Inventor's Wednesday! Zoom in on a gadget until it looks like a machine from the future.
game.prompt: A tool, gizmo or kitchen gadget, shot so close it looks like a part off a spaceship.

game.intro: Low tide, rowboat stuck. Paddle out with the most wrong answer you can row.
game.question: How many oars does a rowboat usually have?

game.intro: Eve of the May Parade! Every float needs a soundtrack. Make yours and let your friend guess it.
game.prompt: A parade sound: a marching drum, a tuba warming up, a tiny fire truck siren, a crowd going wild.
